_comment: Bigness, wherever bigness is a thing the part of the world can be. The tag query picks monumental
landforms and the `sunsize` it sets fills a good part of the sky, and attachment decides which is
meant: `colossal landmass` is the rock, `colossal sun` is the star, and a colossal Age is both.
The query is flat rather than keyed because `monumental` means the same thing everywhere it is
carried; a sun carries no tags at all, so asking it costs nothing and finds nothing.
